title: In-app guided room capture (ARKit poses + depth, coverage, blur, quality gate)
summary: Guided capture in the app (room walkthrough + tabletop orbital, one illustrated toggle): record video with ARKit camera poses and depth, live coverage and speed coaching, blur rejection, and a pre-upload quality gate, producing an upload bundle for reconstruction (the capture→reconstruction contract). Coaching UI follows the locked DESIGN_SYSTEM §6; the pre-upload gate uses an on-device reconstruction-readiness score (coverage, overlap/parallax, blur, light, tracking continuity). Includes both mode coaching scripts, failure/recovery (tracking-loss relocalize, resume, downstream free retry), and first-run guided capture per SPEC §3.1 (AUTH #025). The on-device predictor + multi-pass 'add a pass' loop is M1-CAPT-04.

acceptance_tests.test: A capture session records video plus per-frame ARKit poses, camera intrinsics, available LiDAR depth, the gravity/up vector and metric scale, and the mode + readiness score + coverage map into a bundle matching the upload contract in services/reconstruction (one shape shared with the M0-CAPT-01 corpus manifest); a session over a real room produces a valid bundle.
acceptance_tests.evidence: clip + a sample bundle manifest in the PR

acceptance_tests.test: Coverage feedback, a speed meter, blur rejection, and a pre-upload 'missed corner' hint are present and driven by the capture, per DESIGN_SYSTEM §6.

The pre-upload gate computes an on-device reconstruction-readiness score (coverage, overlap/parallax, blur, light, tracking continuity) and warns kindly on a weak scan ('Too dark here — turn on a lamp?'); it never hard-stops ('Upload anyway' always available); the player can retake; nothing hard-crashes.
GPS and EXIF are stripped on device before the bundle is written; the bundle carries no location metadata.
Active capture stays under 90 s on a normal room; measured on the Owner's iPhone.

Failure/recovery holds: ARKit tracking loss relocalizes and keeps coverage; an interruption (call/app-switch) offers Resume or Start over; a downstream reconstruction failure returns a kind, free retry that preserves the mode. The first capture after the demo shows a one-time richer coach-through.

history.event: sharpened under AUTH #025 (capture UX + coaching): reconstruction-readiness gate signals (AT-3); named upload-contract contents (AT-1); both mode coaching scripts; failure/recovery + first-run coach-through (AT-6). On-device predictor + multi-pass loop split to M1-CAPT-04.
